gold.user: As a Twilio user, I want to retrieve a list of my mobile incoming phone numbers so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of mobile phone numbers associated with my account, including details like phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a Twilio user, I want to create a new mobile incoming phone number so that I can receive calls and messages on it.
gold.ideal: The API should accept parameters such as the phone number and friendly name, and return a confirmation of the newly created mobile number with its details.
